// A track of tangent keyframes, for curves authored with explicit handles.
// Keys are ordered by ascending Time.
type TangentTrack<T>
    implements ITimeVarying<T>
{
    Keys: Array<TangentKeyframe<T>>;
    Before: Extrapolation;
    After: Extrapolation;
}
